title: CURRENCY ( -1.00006 ) is -1.0001: a negative value rounds to the nearest, not toward zero

source.quote: Rounding up occurs if the 5th significant decimal is equal or larger than 5
source.supports: CURRENCY rounds on the fifth decimal; the page gives 3.6666666666666 as 3.6667 and 3.0123456789 as 3.0123

source.quote: truncating the values past the four digits to the right of decimal separator
source.supports: the other reading: the fixed decimal type truncates past four decimals

derivation: The fifth decimal of -1.00006 is 6, which is 5 or larger, so the fourth decimal rounds in magnitude: -1.0001. The value is not a tie (the nearest multiple of 0.0001 is -1.0001).
alternative: The CURRENCY page speaks of 'rounding up' and shows positive numbers only, and the data types page says the type truncates. Truncation, or rounding up toward positive infinity, gives -1.0 (the decimal -1.0000).
